items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Whitney and I stayed quite a bit in touch until his death, you know? We felt a little proud of each other after leaving the campus.

ctx.x: I must have been nuts. 17, 18 years old, you know. But after I got into it I liked it. And even Whitney Young was there. He was right in the line with me. You know?
Did he major in sociology because it was popular too?
